mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of FEDFUNDS<0.5% periods (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls increase exceeding 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >60% of PAYEMS>200 periods (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO > 100.5) and declining unemployment (UNRATE < 5.5%) indicate robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of INDPRO>100.5 AND UNRATE<5.5 periods (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year) triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL>5.0 periods (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates tight labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of UNRATE<4.0 periods (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts increase exceeding 150,000 units signals strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >60% of HOUST>150 periods (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS > 600 million) and industrial production (INDPRO > 100.5) indicate robust consumer and business activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >60% of RSAFS>600 AND INDPRO>100.5 periods (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >60% of INDPRO<100.0 periods (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline).
